plan.title: Glasshouse Field Notes
plan.grammar: A tiny first-person dungeon RPG: three botanists enter one overgrown greenhouse wing, walk its aisles, and fight local plant/fungal hazards using a Project-owned two-element skill vocabulary.
plan.startup: Ordinary title -> new session -> Project map. The fixed starting party is the three botanists and the greenhouse has a guaranteed local encounter rate.
plan.playableProof: Choose Begin, walk through the greenhouse, and enter a battle against Glass Mold; the party and enemy use only this Project's skills/elements.
plan.contentBudget: One compact greenhouse map, three player Units, one enemy Unit, three skills, two elements.
